            <div class="hero-image-wrap">

        <div class="blog-content">
            <p>While the Balearic Islands offer countless nautical routes, the <strong>boat trip from Mallorca to
                    Formentera</strong> stands alone as the ultimate maritime pilgrimage. This journey represents a
                transition from the mountainous grandeur of Mallorca to the flat, turquoise paradise of Formentera—often
                called the "Caribbean of Europe." In this 1,500-word authority guide, we break down everything required
                to execute this trip with absolute precision and luxury.</p>

            <div class="snippet-box">
                <h4>Quick Answer: The Crossing</h4>
                <p>A private <strong>boat trip from Mallorca to Formentera</strong> covers approximately 70 nautical
                    miles. On a high-performance luxury motor yacht (like a VanDutch 55 or Pardo 50), the journey takes
                    <strong>2 to 3 hours</strong>. Prices for a private day charter start at approximately
                    <strong>€2,500</strong> plus fuel and VAT.</p>
            </div>

            <h2 id="vessel">Selecting the Ultimate Vessel: Speed vs. Stature</h2>
            <p>Your choice of vessel defines the nature of your boat trip from Mallorca to Formentera. Because the
                crossing involves open water (the Balearic Channel), stability and speed are paramount. For those
                seeking the 2026 standard of luxury, we recommend three distinct classes of vessels:</p>

            <h3>1. The High-Speed Day Cruiser (The VanDutch / Pardo Class)</h3>
            <p>If you want to maximize your time in Formentera’s turquoise waters, a high-speed cruiser is essential.
                Vessels like the <strong>VanDutch 55</strong> or the <strong>Pardo 50</strong> are designed for these
                crossings. With a cruising speed of 28-32 knots, they slash travel time while providing an ultra-sleek,
                social deck layout perfect for sunset cocktails on the return leg.</p>

            <h3>2. The Luxury Motor Yacht (The Sunseeker / Princess Class)</h3>
            <p>For those who value comfort and onboard amenities, a 60ft+ motor yacht is the gold standard. These yachts
                offer stabilize systems that eliminate roll during the crossing, full galleys for chef-prepared meals,
                and luxurious cabins for mid-day siestas in air-conditioned comfort.</p>

            <h3>3. The Power Catamaran (The Lagoon / Sunreef Class)</h3>
            <p>Rapidly becoming the most requested vessel for 2026, the power catamaran offers unparalleled deck space
                and stability. For families or larger groups, a catamaran provides a "floating beach club" experience
                that traditional monohulls cannot match.</p>

            <h2 id="route">The Mallorca to Formentera Route: A Scenic Deep Dive</h2>
            <p>The standard departure for a <strong>boat trip from Mallorca to Formentera</strong> is from the southwest
                of the island. Ports like <strong>Port d'Andratx</strong> or <strong>Puerto Portals</strong> are
                preferred as they minimize the initial transit time through the Bay of Palma.</p>
            <p>As you leave the rugged coastline of Mallorca behind, the depth of the Balearic Sea increases, and the
                water color shifts to a deep, royal indigo. Approximately halfway through the crossing, the silhouette
                of Ibiza begins to appear on the horizon, but your target remains the narrow, low-lying strip of white
                sand that is Formentera.</p>

            <h2 id="beachclubs">VIP Beach Club Access: Formentera's Elite Scene</h2>
            <p>The boat trip is only half the experience. The arrival in Formentera, specifically at <strong>Ses
                    Illetes</strong>, is a spectacle. Formentera’s beach clubs are among the most exclusive in the
                world, and arriving via private yacht tender is the only way to make an entrance.</p>

            <h3>Beso Beach Formentera</h3>
            <p>The world-renowned "No Hay Verano Sin Beso" atmosphere. A reservation here is mandatory months in
                advance. The cuisine is rustic Mediterranean, but the energy is electric. Our concierge team manages
                these reservations to ensure your table is ready the moment you step off your tender.</p>

            <h3>Juan y Andrea</h3>
            <p>A Formentera institution. Located directly on the sand of Ses Illetes, Juan y Andrea is famous for its
                salt-crusted fish and its elite clientele. There are no roads here; you must arrive by sea. It is the
                pinnacle of the Formentera lifestyle.</p>

            <h2 id="secretstops">Secret Coves & Anchorages: Beyond the Crowds</h2>
            <p>While Ses Illetes is the headline act, a private <strong>boat trip from Mallorca to Formentera</strong>
                allows you to explore locations that 99% of tourists never see. We recommend anchoring at <strong>Es
                    Palmador</strong>—a private island just north of Formentera. Here, the water is so shallow and clear
                it feels like a swimming pool. The island has no buildings, only pristine nature and the occasional
                celebrity yacht anchored offshore.</p>
            <p>Another "insider" secret is <strong>Caló des Mort</strong>. Tucked away on the southern tip of the
                island, this tiny cove is surrounded by ochre cliffs and offers some of the best snorkeling in the
                Balearics.</p>

            <h2 id="costs">Cost Breakdown & Logistics: Investing in the Experience</h2>
            <p>Planning a boat trip of this magnitude requires an understanding of the maritime economics involved. In

            <p><em>Note: All prices are subject to 21% VAT and typically include a professional skipper, complimentary

            <h2 id="itinerary">The Perfect 10-Hour Itinerary</h2>
            <p>To maximize your <strong>boat trip from Mallorca to Formentera</strong>, we recommend the following
                timeline:</p>
            <ul>
                <li><strong>09:00 AM:</strong> Departure from Port d'Andratx. Enjoy a light breakfast on deck.</li>
                <li><strong>11:30 AM:</strong> Arrival at Es Palmador for the first swim of the day.</li>
                <li><strong>01:30 PM:</strong> Tender transfer to Juan y Andrea for a world-class lunch.</li>
                <li><strong>04:00 PM:</strong> Relaxation on the yacht's sunbeds, cruising the coast of Formentera
                    toward Cala Saona.</li>
                <li><strong>06:00 PM:</strong> Sunset cocktails at the anchorage before the return crossing.</li>
                <li><strong>08:30 PM:</strong> Arrival back in Mallorca as the stars appear.</li>
            </ul>

            <h2 id="faq">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
            <div class="faq-grid">
                <div class="faq-item">
                    <h4>Is it safe to cross from Mallorca to Formentera in a small boat?</h4>
                    <p>We do not recommend making this crossing in anything smaller than 35ft. The Balearic Channel is
                        subject to sudden changes in wind. All Elite Luxury Bookings vessels are chosen for their
                        sea-keeping capabilities and are helmed by experienced captains.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="faq-item">

                </div>

Mallorca to Ibiza Private Boat Charter: 7 Brilliant Tips

Curated by the Elite Luxury Concierge Team

Dreaming of a Mallorca to Ibiza private boat Charter adventure? Skip the crowded ferries and discover the most spectacular, flexible, and luxurious way to island-hop across the Mediterranean. A private charter puts you completely in control of your own sun-drenched adventure.

Whether youâ€™re planning a romantic escape, a VIP group holiday, or a once-in-a-lifetime family voyage, this guide covers everything you need to know: the best boat types, realistic costs, expert booking tips, and a full 7-day itinerary.

1. Why Choose a Mallorca to Ibiza Private Boat Charter?

Public ferries run on fixed schedules and fixed routes. A private boat charter gives you total freedom: depart at sunrise, anchor in a hidden cove for lunch, and arrive in Ibiza in time for the legendary sunset at Es VedrÃ .

Some of the most breathtaking spots in the Balearics â€” crystal-clear lagoons and deserted white sand beaches â€” are completely unreachable by road. A private boat charter on the Mallorca to Ibiza route gives you direct access to these secret gems.

2. Route Facts: Distance, Duration & Best Departure Points

The distance between Palma de Mallorca and Ibiza Town is approximately 81 nautical miles (150 km). A high-speed private motorboat can cover this in under 3 hours, while a sailing catamaran might take 5-7 hours for a more relaxed voyage.

Top Departure Ports in Mallorca

  • Palma de Mallorca (Club de Mar) â€” The most popular hub with the widest charter fleet.
  • Port dâ€™Andratx â€” An upscale marina in the southwest, closer to Ibiza and ideal for a scenic start.
  • Santa Ponsa â€” A quieter option favoured by smaller private charters.

3. 7 Brilliant Private Boat Options

Choosing the right vessel defines your experience. Here are the top configurations for the Mallorca-Ibiza crossing:

  • Luxury Motor Yacht â€” The gold standard for speed and onboard comfort, reaching Ibiza in 3-4 hours with a professional crew.
  • Private Speedboat â€” The exciting express, perfect for day trips covering the crossing in under 2.5 hours.
  • Sailing Catamaran â€” The dreamer's choice, wide and stable, allowing for a relaxed crossing where the journey is the destination.

4. How Much Does a Mallorca to Ibiza Private Boat Cost?

Day charter prices for a single-day crossing typically range from â‚¬800 for a small speedboat to â‚¬15,000+ for a large luxury yacht. For multi-day or weekly charters, sailing catamarans start from â‚¬7,000/week, while superyachts can exceed â‚¬200,000/week.

5. Perfect 7-Day Private Boat Itinerary

  • Day 1 â€” Palma de Mallorca: Embark and explore the old town.
  • Day 2 â€” Port dâ€™Andratx: Swim in the crystal-clear waters of Cala Fornells.
  • Day 3 â€” Crossing Day: Depart early, lunch at anchor near Espalmador islet.
  • Day 4 â€” Northern Ibiza: Discover Portinatx and the mud baths of Cala Xarraca.
  • Day 5 â€” Ibiza Town: UNESCO-listed Dalt Vila and world-class nightlife.
  • Day 6 â€” Formentera Day Trip: Turquoise waters of Playa de Ses Illetes.
  • Day 7 â€” Disembark: Final morning swim before returning to reality.

6. FAQs: Mallorca to Ibiza Private Boat Charter

How long does the Mallorca to Ibiza private boat Charter crossing take?

A fast motor yacht takes 2.5-3 hours. A sailing catamaran spread the journey over 6-8 hours depending on wind conditions and anchor stops.

Can I do a Mallorca to Ibiza private boat Charter day trip?

Yes, a one-day round trip is entirely possible on a fast motor yacht or speedboat. Depart Mallorca at 8-9am and return in the early evening.

Do I need a sailing licence?

No, most charters are skippered by a professional captain. If you wish to bareboat charter, you will need a recognised qualification such as RYA Day Skipper.

                <h4>Featured Snippet: Private Boat Trip Mallorca to Formentera</h4>
                <p>The <strong>private boat trip from Mallorca to Formentera</strong> is a 70-nautical-mile
                    crossing that takes <strong>2 to 3.5 hours</strong> depending on your vessel. A private day
                    charter typically starts at <strong>€2,500 + fuel</strong>. The best itinerary departs from
                    <strong>Port d'Andratx</strong> or <strong>Palma</strong>, arriving at the world-famous
                    <strong>Ses Illetes beach</strong> for a late lunch at <strong>Juan y Andrea</strong> or
                    <strong>Beso Beach</strong>.
                </p>
            </div>

            <div class="snippet-box">
                <h4>Why Book Through Elite Luxury Bookings?</h4>

                <ul class="luxury-list">
                    <li>Access to premium charter operators across Mallorca</li>
                    <li>Luxury motor yachts, catamarans and superyachts</li>
                    <li>Personal concierge assistance</li>
                    <li>Fast quote turnaround</li>
                    <li>Exclusive itinerary recommendations</li>
                </ul>

            </div>

            <p>For those who have already experienced the rugged majesty of Mallorca’s Tramuntana mountains and
                the cosmopolitan energy of Palma, there remains one final maritime challenge: the crossing to
                Formentera. Often referred to as the "Caribbean of Europe," Formentera is a flat, ethereal
                limestone shelf surrounded by some of the clearest water on the planet.</p>

            <p>Whether you are planning a romantic escape, family yacht charter or VIP day trip, our team can source
                luxury motor yachts, catamarans and superyachts tailored to your travel dates and preferences. Submit an
                inquiry to receive available yacht options, pricing and availability.</p>

            <div class="toc-box">
                <h3>Maritime Navigation Roadmap</h3>
                <ul class="toc-list">
                    <li><a href="#logic">1. The Logistics of the Crossing</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#vessels">2. Selecting Your Elite Vessel</a></li>

                    <li><a href="#anchor">5. The Formentera Anchorages & Secret Coves</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#gastronomy">6. Gastronomy: The Beach Club Scene</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#technical">7. Captain's Technical Insights & Safety</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#costs">8. Cost Analysis & Pricing Breakdown</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#itinerary">9. Sailing Itineraries: Day Trip & 7-Day Journey</a></li>
                </ul>

            <h2 id="logic">1. The Logistics of the Crossing: Distance & Time</h2>
            <p>The journey from the southwestern tip of Mallorca to the northern point of Formentera covers approximately 70 to 75 nautical miles (about 65 to 90 nautical miles depending on your exact departure and arrival ports). This is not a casual bay cruise; it is an open-sea crossing of the Balearic Channel. Understanding the physics of this journey is critical for setting expectations.</p>
            <p>As you leave the rugged coastline of Mallorca behind, the depth of the Balearic Sea increases, and the water color shifts to a deep, royal indigo. Approximately halfway through the crossing, the silhouette of Ibiza begins to appear on the horizon, but your target remains the narrow, low-lying strip of white sand that is Formentera.</p>
            <p><strong>Travel Time:</strong> A modern luxury speedboat (Pardo 50 or VanDutch 55) cruising at 28-30 knots will make the trip in roughly <strong>2.5 hours</strong>. A larger, 80ft+ superyacht cruising at a more stately 20 knots will require <strong>3.5 to 4 hours</strong>. If you choose a monohull sailboat under sail, the direct passage will take between <strong>10 and 14 hours</strong>. We always recommend a "weather-first" approach; the channel can become choppy in the afternoon if the 'Embata' (sea breeze) is strong.</p>

            <h2 id="vessels">2. Selecting Your Elite Vessel: The Fleet</h2>
            <p>In the world of <strong>private boat hire Mallorca Formentera</strong>, your choice of vessel defines your status, comfort, and relationship with the sea. We offer five primary classes of maritime engineering, available for bareboat or crewed charter:</p>

            <h3>The High-Speed Day Cruiser (VanDutch / Pardo)</h3>
            <p>This is the preferred choice for couples and smaller groups (up to 10 pax) who prioritize speed and style. The VanDutch 55, with its iconic plumb bow and vast social cockpit, is the ultimate style statement. It allows you to depart Mallorca at 10:00 AM and be at anchor in Ses Illetes by 12:30 PM, ready for lunch.</p>

            <h3>The Power Catamaran (Sunreef / Lagoon)</h3>
            <p>For families or groups (up to 10-12 guests) who demand stability, the power catamaran is the ultimate "floating beach club." With a beam (width) often exceeding 30 feet, these vessels offer 40% more deck space than a traditional monohull. They feature a very shallow draft, allowing you to anchor closer to the pristine Formentera shoreline.</p>

            <h3>The Performance Motor Yacht (Sunseeker / Pershing / Princess)</h3>
            <p>If you want to cross the channel in absolute silence and air-conditioned comfort, a 60ft+ motor yacht is the gold standard. These yachts feature zero-speed stabilizers that eliminate the roll of the sea while at anchor, full galleys for chef-prepared meals, and luxurious cabins for mid-day siestas.</p>

            <h3>The Monohull Sailboat (Beneteau / Jeanneau)</h3>
            <p>Perfect for couples and purist sailors who value the authentic sailing experience. A valid offshore license (like an ICC or RYA Day Skipper) is required for bareboat, or you can hire a professional skipper to handle the sails.</p>

            <h3>The Luxury Gulet & Superyacht</h3>
            <p>For larger groups, corporate events, or the ultimate bespoke luxury experience, a superyacht (80ft+) with a professional crew and private chef offers unmatched comfort and service on the water.</p>

            <h2 id="ports">3. Departure Ports: Palma, Andratx & Portals</h2>
            <p>Where you begin your boat trip significantly impacts the journey's duration and aesthetic. We recommend three departure points along Mallorca's southwest coast to minimize channel transit time:</p>

            <h3>Port de Palma: The Superyacht Hub</h3>
            <p>For those chartering vessels over 80 feet, Palma is the epicenter. Departing from Club de Mar or Palma's central marinas allows you to cruise past the imposing gothic cathedral before hitting the open channel. The journey to Formentera from Palma is approximately 75 nautical miles.</p>

            <h3>Port d'Andratx: The Western Vanguard</h3>
            <p>If your villa is located in the southwest (Son Vida, Portals Nous, Andratx), departing from Port d'Andratx trims roughly 15 miles off the open-water crossing, making it the preferred launch pad for high-speed day cruisers.</p>

            <h3>Puerto Portals: The Glamorous Alternative</h3>
            <p>An upscale marina nestled in the heart of Calvià, offering high-end yacht options and a luxury shopping and dining scene to explore before embarkation.</p>

            <h2 id="routes">4. The 7 Best Sailing Routes</h2>
            <p>The classic direct passage is just one of many ways to complete a charter between Mallorca and Formentera. These seven routes represent the full spectrum of Balearic sailing:</p>

            <ul class="luxury-list">
                <li><strong>The Classic Direct (Palma to Formentera):</strong> Direct south-southwest crossing of the channel. Approximately 75 nautical miles, 10–12 hours under sail (or 3-4 hours on a motor yacht). Ideal for maximizing time at the destination.</li>
                <li><strong>The Island Passage (Via Cabrera & Ibiza):</strong> Sail through the protected Cabrera National Park before continuing to Ibiza's south coast and the final leg to Formentera. The most popular multi-day itinerary.</li>
                <li><strong>South Coast Explorer (Portocolom to Formentera):</strong> Starting from Portocolom on Mallorca's east coast (one of the finest natural harbors in the Balearics), reducing passage time and allowing more time to explore Formentera's 69-kilometer coastline.</li>
                <li><strong>The Overnight Crossing (Sunset Departure):</strong> Depart at dusk and navigate by moonlight. The Balearic Channel at night offers absolute darkness and an unobstructed starry sky, arriving at dawn.</li>
                <li><strong>The Full Balearic Loop:</strong> For longer charters of 10-14 days: Mallorca → Menorca → Ibiza → Formentera → Mallorca. Over 300 nautical miles covering four distinct islands.</li>
                <li><strong>Luxury Anchorage Route (Via Es Trenc):</strong> Cruise Mallorca's southern shoreline with an overnight anchorage at the wild Es Trenc beach before making the crossing.</li>
                <li><strong>Express Charter (Private Motor Yacht):</strong> Make the crossing in just 3–4 hours, ideal for a weekend escape or a luxury day trip.</li>
            </ul>

            <h2 id="anchor">5. The Formentera Anchorages & Secret Coves</h2>
            <p>The comparison to the Caribbean is born in Formentera’s anchorages. Posidonia seagrass meadows filter the water to a crystalline clarity, creating a mesmerizing optical illusion where yachts appear to hover above the seabed. With a private charter, you can access places 99% of tourists never see:</p>

            <div style="margin: 2rem 0; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
                <img src="/assets/images/ses_illetes_anchorage.png" alt="Aerial view of luxury superyachts anchored in the electric blue waters of Playa de Ses Illetes" style="width: 100%; height: auto; display: block;">
            </div>

            <ul class="luxury-list">
                <li><strong>Playa de Ses Illetes:</strong> The most famous strip of sand in the Mediterranean. Expect superyachts stacked three rows deep in shallow, warm, electric blue waters.</li>
                <li><strong>Espalmador:</strong> A privately-owned, uninhabited islet just north of Formentera. Drop anchor here in total seclusion for a morning swim before the crowds arrive.</li>
                <li><strong>Cala Saona:</strong> A sheltered bay on the western coast with red cliffs, offering complete protection from easterly winds and stunning sunset views.</li>
                <li><strong>Caló des Mort:</strong> Tucked away on the southern tip of Formentera, this tiny, quiet cove surrounded by ochre cliffs offers some of the best snorkeling in the Balearics.</li>
                <li><strong>Playa de Migjorn & Llevant:</strong> Expansive white sand beaches providing excellent anchorage spots away from the busier northern point.</li>
            </ul>

            <h2 id="gastronomy">6. Gastronomy: The Beach Club Scene</h2>
            <p>No boat trip is complete without stepping ashore for a long, relaxed lunch. Formentera’s beach clubs operate at the pinnacle of Mediterranean gastronomy, offering fresh seafood and direct tender services for arriving yachts:</p>

            <div style="margin: 2rem 0; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
                <img src="/assets/images/formentera_beach_club.png" alt="Luxury beach club restaurant setting on the white sand of Formentera" style="width: 100%; height: auto; display: block;">
            </div>

            <h3>Juan y Andrea</h3>
            <p>The undisputed king of Ses Illetes. Located directly on the sand with no road access, you will be tendered ashore by the restaurant's private zodiac. Order the salt-baked sea bass and enjoy the elite Balearic lifestyle. <em>(Reservations must be secured weeks in advance—our concierge handles this seamlessly).</em></p>

            <h3>Beso Beach Formentera</h3>
            <p>Famous for its bohemian-chic "No Hay Verano Sin Beso" atmosphere. Located right on the beach, it features exceptional Mediterranean-Spanish fusion paellas, rustic decor, and an energetic sunset crowd.</p>

            <h2 id="technical">7. Captain's Technical Insights & Safety</h2>
            <p>An open-water crossing of the Balearic Channel demands respect. A 70-nautical-mile journey is heavily reliant on weather conditions and marine forecasts. Here is what experienced captains advise:</p>
            <ul class="luxury-list">
                <li><strong>Departure Window:</strong> The optimal departure time is between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM. In the summer, the Balearic Sea is typically glassy in the morning, while thermal winds ('Embata') can build chop in the afternoon.</li>
                <li><strong>Minimum Vessel Size:</strong> We do not recommend making this crossing in any boat smaller than 35 feet. A larger vessel (60ft+) provides maximum comfort and stability in the channel.</li>
                <li><strong>Anchoring Permits & Posidonia:</strong> Ses Illetes and Espalmador require advance anchoring permits during July and August to protect the delicate Posidonia seagrass. Your operator will arrange this, but verify it when booking.</li>
                <li><strong>Cash Reserves:</strong> Mooring buoys in Cabrera and water taxis in Formentera can be cash-only. We recommend keeping €200–€300 in cash onboard.</li>
            </ul>

            <h2 id="costs">8. Cost Analysis & Pricing Breakdown</h2>
            <p>Pricing for a private boat hire is dependent on the vessel class and charter duration. Because of the long crossing distance, fuel consumption is a key factor in the final cost. Additional operational expenses are structured as follows:</p>

            <ul class="luxury-list">
                <li><strong>VAT:</strong> 21% Spanish VAT is standard and typically added to the base charter rate.</li>
                <li><strong>Fuel:</strong> Ranges from €100 to €400+ per day depending on the speed and engine size of the vessel (or €800–€2,500 roundtrip for fast motor yachts).</li>
                <li><strong>Formentera Marina & Mooring:</strong> Mooring buoys or marina berths range from €50 to €300+ per night.</li>
                <li><strong>Provisioning:</strong> Expect €30 to €80 per person daily for food and beverages onboard.</li>
                <li><strong>Crew Gratuity:</strong> 10% to 15% of the base charter rate is standard for professional skippers and crew.</li>
                <li><strong>Security Deposit:</strong> A refundable deposit of €1,000 to €3,000 is standard for bareboat charters.</li>
            </ul>

            <div class="snippet-box">
                <h4>Total Weekly Investment Estimate</h4>
                <p>For a group of six sharing a quality crewed catamaran for a 7-day charter, the total budget typically ranges between <strong>€7,000 and €14,000</strong>. This represents exceptional value, breaking down to approximately <strong>€160 to €330 per person per day</strong> for a completely private yacht holiday.</p>
            </div>

            <h2 id="itinerary">9. Sailing Itineraries: Day Trip & 7-Day Journey</h2>
            <p>Whether you have a single day or a full week, we have developed the ultimate Balearic itineraries:</p>

            <h3>The 10-Hour Day Trip Blueprint</h3>
            <ul class="luxury-list">
                <li><strong>10:00 AM:</strong> Embarkation from Port d'Andratx or Palma. Fresh pastries and refreshments served on deck.</li>
                <li><strong>12:30 PM:</strong> Arrive at Espalmador islet. Drop anchor for a secluded swim in crystal-clear waters.</li>
                <li><strong>02:00 PM:</strong> Cruise to Ses Illetes. Tender ashore for a salt-baked fish lunch at Juan y Andrea.</li>
                <li><strong>05:00 PM:</strong> Return to the yacht for sunset cocktails, cruising along the dramatic western cliffs of Ibiza.</li>
                <li><strong>08:00 PM:</strong> Arrive back in Mallorca. Chauffeured transfer back to your villa.</li>
            </ul>

            <h3>The 7-Day Balearic Island Itinerary</h3>
            <ul class="luxury-list">
                <li><strong>Day 1 (Palma to Portocolom):</strong> Depart Palma late morning. Sail 35 nm east along Mallorca's southern coast. Overnight at anchor in Portocolom's natural harbor.</li>
                <li><strong>Day 2 (Portocolom to Cabrera):</strong> Sail 15 nm south to the protected Cabrera National Park. Snorkel marine caves and hike to the historic fortress.</li>
                <li><strong>Day 3 (Cabrera to Ibiza Town):</strong> Cross the channel (42 nm southwest, 6-8 hours). Anchor and explore Dalt Vila, Ibiza's walled UNESCO city.</li>
                <li><strong>Day 4 (Ibiza South Coast):</strong> Day sail past the legendary Es Vedrà rock. Anchor at Cala Vadella for swimming and paddleboarding.</li>
                <li><strong>Day 5 (Ibiza to Formentera):</strong> A short 6 nm leg to Ses Illetes. Anchor for lunch at Beso Beach and explore the white sand dunes.</li>
                <li><strong>Day 6 (Formentera Circular):</strong> Circumnavigate Formentera. Snorkel Caló des Mort, visit Far de la Mola cliffs, and watch the sunset from the deck.</li>
                <li><strong>Day 7 (Return to Mallorca):</strong> Cross back to Mallorca or disembark in Ibiza. Option to extend via our Mallorca to Ibiza route guide.</li>
            </ul>

            <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>

            <div class="faq-item">
                <h4>How much does a private yacht charter from Mallorca to Formentera cost?</h4>
                <p>Day charters typically start from €2,500 for a luxury speedboat or motor yacht, and can exceed €10,000 depending on vessel size and season. For week-long charters, mid-range crewed catamarans cost €10,000–€18,000, while luxury superyachts start from €30,000+ per week. Rates exclude fuel, provisioning, and local marina fees.</p>
            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">
                <h4>How long does the boat trip take?</h4>
                <p>The crossing typically takes between 2 to 3.5 hours on a modern luxury motor yacht (cruising at 20-30 knots) and 10 to 14 hours under sail for a monohull sailboat.</p>
            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">
                <h4>Do I need a sailing license to charter a yacht in Mallorca?</h4>

        function escapeHtml(text) {
            if (!text) return '';
            return text.toString()
                .replace(/&/g, "&")
                .replace(/</g, "<")
                .replace(/>/g, ">");
        }

        async function submitLead(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const form = event.target;
            const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
            const originalBtnText = btn.innerText;
            
            btn.innerText = 'SENDING...';
            btn.disabled = true;
            
            const formData = new FormData(form);
            const formType = formData.get('form_type') || 'Mallorca to Formentera Yacht Lead';
            
            // Format message for Telegram
            let message = `🚀 <b>New Elite Lead Received!</b>\n\n`;
            message += `<b>Source:</b> ${escapeHtml(formType)}\n\n`;
            
            const fields = {
                name: '👤 Name',
                phone: '📞 Phone',
                email: '✉️ Email',
                date: '📅 Preferred Date',
                pax: '👥 Guests',
                vessel_preference: '⚓ Vessel Pref',
                budget: '💰 Budget'
            };
            
            for (const [key, label] of Object.entries(fields)) {
                const val = formData.get(key);
                if (val) {
                    message += `<b>${label}:</b> ${escapeHtml(val)}\n`;
                }
            }
            
            for (const [key, val] of formData.entries()) {
                if (!fields[key] && !['form_type', '_redirect', '_target', '_subject', '_cc'].includes(key) && val) {
                    const formattedKey = key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1);
                    message += `<b>${formattedKey}:</b> ${escapeHtml(val)}\n`;
                }
            }
            message += `\n⏰ ${new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substr(0, 19)} UTC`;
            
            // 1. Send to Telegram
            const tgPromise = fetch('/submit-lead.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    chat_id: '5875175296',
                    text: message,
                    parse_mode: 'HTML'
                })
            }).then(r => r.json()).catch(err => ({ ok: false, error: err }));
            
            // 2. Send to Email via Formsubmit.co
            const formObject = {};
            formData.forEach((value, key) => {
                if (!['_redirect', '_cc', '_subject'].includes(key)) {
                    formObject[key] = value;
                }
            });
            formObject['_subject'] = `New Lead: ${formType}`;
            
            const emailPromise = fetch('https://formsubmit.co/ajax/contactshaikk@gmail.com', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(formObject)
            }).then(r => r.json()).catch(err => ({ success: false, error: err }));
            
            try {
                await Promise.all([tgPromise, emailPromise]);
                form.style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('formSuccessMessage').style.display = 'block';
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(error);
                alert('Connection issue. Please connect directly via WhatsApp.');
            } finally {
                btn.innerText = originalBtnText;
                btn.disabled = false;
            }
        }
    </script>

      list-style: none !important;
      flex: 1 !important;
      justify-content: center !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) !important;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      font-size: 0.82rem !important;
      text-transform: uppercase !important;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px !important;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem !important;
      border-radius: 6px !important;
      transition: all 0.4s !important;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: #D4AF37 !important;
    }

    .nav-hamburger {
      display: none !important;
      flex-direction: column !important;
      gap: 5px !important;
      cursor: pointer !important;
      padding: 0.5rem !important;
      z-index: 100001 !important;
    }

    .nav-hamburger span {
      display: block !important;
      width: 24px !important;
      height: 2px !important;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) !important;
      border-radius: 2px !important;
      transition: all 0.4s !important;
    }

    .nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px) !important;
    }

    .nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0 !important;
    }

    .nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(4px, -4px) !important;
    }

    .mobile-menu {
      display: none !important;
      position: fixed !important;
      top: 0 !important;
      left: 0 !important;
      right: 0 !important;
      bottom: 0 !important;
      background: #050505 !important;
      padding: 72px 2rem 2rem !important;
      z-index: 100000 !important;
      flex-direction: column !important;
      gap: 0.5rem !important;
      overflow-y: auto !important;
    }

    .mobile-menu.open {
      display: flex !important;
    }

    .mobile-menu a {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) !important;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      font-size: 1.1rem !important;
      text-transform: uppercase !important;
      letter-spacing: 2px !important;
      padding: 1.2rem 0 !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
    }

    @media (max-width:1024px) {
      .nav-links {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .nav-hamburger {
        display: flex !important;
      }
    }

    body:has(.top-intel-bar) {
      padding-top: 108px !important;
    }

    @media (max-width:768px) {
      .top-intel-bar {
        height: 32px !important;
      }

      .top-intel-bar~.global-nav {
        top: 32px !important;
      }

      body:has(.top-intel-bar) {
        padding-top: 104px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ===== BREADCRUMB ===== */
    .breadcrumb {
      padding: 1.5rem 0;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    .breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .breadcrumb a:hover {
      color: var(--gold-light);
    }

    .breadcrumb span {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    }

    /* ===== BLOG HEADER ===== */
    .blog-header {
      padding: 3rem 0 2rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .blog-meta {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }

    .blog-header h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 300;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .blog-byline {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    /* ===== HERO IMAGE ===== */
    .hero-image-container {
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .blog-hero-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    .hero-image-container img {
      transition: transform 0.8s ease;
    }

    .hero-image-container:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.02);
    }

    .img-caption {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ===== QUICK ANSWER ===== */
    .quick-answer {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--primary-gold);
      padding: 2.5rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .quick-answer::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--primary-gold), transparent);
    }

    .quick-answer h4 {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    .quick-answer p {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* ===== TABLE OF CONTENTS ===== */
    .toc-box {
      background: var(--graphene);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 2rem 2.5rem;
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
    }

    .toc-box h3 {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    }

    .toc-box ol {
      padding-left: 1.5rem;
    }

    .toc-box ol li {
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }

    .toc-box a {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
    }

    .toc-box a:hover {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    /* ===== BLOG CONTENT ===== */
    .blog-content {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: #ddd;
    }

    .blog-content p {
      margin-bottom: 1.6rem;
    }

    .blog-content h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
      margin: 3.5rem 0 1.2rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--primary-gold);
      padding-left: 1.2rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .blog-content h3 {
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
      margin: 2.5rem 0 1rem;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .blog-content h4 {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      margin: 2rem 0 0.8rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    /* ===== LUXURY LIST ===== */
    .luxury-list {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 1.5rem 0;
    }

    .luxury-list li {
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
      padding-left: 2rem;
      position: relative;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .luxury-list li::before {
      content: '✦';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      top: 4px;
    }

    /* ===== PRICING TABLE ===== */
    .pricing-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin: 2rem 0;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .pricing-table th {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      text-align: left;
      padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    }

    .pricing-table td {
      padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      color: #ddd;
    }

    .pricing-table tbody tr:last-child td {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .pricing-table tbody tr:hover td {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.03);
    }

    .pricing-table td strong {
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* ===== INLINE CALLOUT ===== */
    .callout-box {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--primary-gold);
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
      padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
      margin: 2rem 0;
    }

    .callout-box p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    }

    .callout-box strong {
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* ===== INLINE IMAGE ===== */
    .inline-img-wrap {
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    }

    .inline-img-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    .inline-img-wrap .img-caption {
      background: rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.7);
    }

    /* ===== VIDEO EMBED ===== */
    .video-wrap {
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--graphene);
      position: relative;
    }

    .video-wrap iframe {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border: none;
      display: block;
    }

    /* ===== TRUST SECTION ===== */
    .trust-section {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 3rem;
      margin: 3.5rem 0;
    }

    .trust-section>h3 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .trust-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .trust-stat-number {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 2.6rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .trust-stat-label {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-top: 0.4rem;
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.12);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
    }

    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: #ddd;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* ===== GALLERY ===== */
    .gallery-section {
      margin: 3.5rem 0;
    }

    .gallery-section>h3 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .gallery-section>p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .gallery-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .gallery-item {
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--graphene-light);
    }

    .gallery-item img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .gallery-item:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.06);
    }

    .gallery-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), transparent);
      padding: 1rem 0.8rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    }

    /* Placeholder when images fail */
    .gallery-placeholder {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      padding: 1rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .gallery-placeholder-icon {
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    .gallery-placeholder-text {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* ===== HERO ENQUIRY FORM ===== */
    .hero-enquiry-form {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 2.5rem;
      margin: 2rem 0;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .hero-enquiry-form h3 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .hero-enquiry-form>p {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .form-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .form-field {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .form-field label {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    .form-field input,
    .form-field select {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }

    .form-field select {
      background-color: #111111;
      color-scheme: dark;
    }

    .form-field input:focus,
    .form-field select:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    .form-field input::placeholder {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    }

    .form-submit-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .form-trust-note {
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    /* ===== BUTTONS ===== */
    .btn-gold {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37, #B8860B);
      color: #000 !important;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: inline-block;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-gold:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.45);
    }

    /* ===== CTA BOX ===== */
    .cta-box {
      background: var(--graphene);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      padding: 4rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      margin: 4rem 0;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cta-box::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--primary-gold), transparent);
    }

    .cta-box h3 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .cta-sub {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .cta-note {
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .cta-note a {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    /* ===== FAQ SECTION ===== */
    .faq-section {
      margin: 4rem 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      padding-top: 3.5rem;
    }

    .faq-section>h2 {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--primary-gold);
      padding-left: 1.2rem;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .faq-item {
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .faq-item:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .faq-item h4 {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    }

    .faq-item p {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: #ccc;
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .faq-item a {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
    }

    /* ===== COMPARISON TABLE ===== */
    .comparison-section {
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
    }

    .comparison-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .comparison-card {
      background: var(--graphene);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 2rem;
    }

    .comparison-card h4 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .comparison-card ul {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .comparison-card ul li {
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: #ccc;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .comparison-card ul li:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .comparison-card ul li span {
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ===== RELATED INTEL ===== */
    .related-intel {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 3rem;
      margin: 4rem 0;
    }

    .related-intel h3 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .related-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: border-color 0.3s, background 0.3s;
    }

    .related-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35);
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05);
    }

    .related-card h4 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--primary-gold);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .related-card p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ===== AUTHOR BOX ===== */
    .author-box {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      align-items: flex-start;
      background: var(--graphene);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 2rem;
      margin: 3rem 0;
    }

    .author-avatar {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .author-info h4 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    }

    .author-info p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== WA FLOAT ===== */
    .wa-float {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 30px;
      right: 30px;
      background: #25D366;
      width: 60px;
      height: 60px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 99999;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    /* ===== STICKY MOBILE CTA ===== */
    .sticky-cta-bar {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 9998;
      background: rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.97);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
      padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;

      <h2 id="distance-time">1. Distance & Journey Time: The 150 km Balearic Gap</h2>

      <p>
        The distance from Mallorca to Ibiza is approximately <strong>150 km (93 nautical miles)</strong> across open
        Mediterranean water. The Balearic Sea can present varying sea states between May and September — glassy calms in
        early morning, occasional afternoon chop by midsummer. Choosing the right vessel for your <strong>Mediterranean crossing</strong> is the single most important factor determining both journey time and on-board comfort.

      <!-- ===== SECTION 3: VESSEL TYPES ===== -->
      <h2 id="vessel-types">3. The 5 Best Vessel Types for the Route</h2>

      <p>
        Not every boat is suited to a 93-mile open-water crossing. At Elite Luxury Bookings, every vessel we recommend
        for a <strong>private boat from Mallorca to Ibiza</strong> has been assessed for speed, stability, passenger
        comfort, and arrival presence. Here are the five that excel on this specific route.
      </p>

      <h3>1. The Chase Boat (Wajer 55 / VanDutch 55)</h3>
      <p>
        These are the status symbols of the Mediterranean. At 30+ knots, a Wajer 55 cuts <strong>the journey</strong> to just over 3 hours while remaining remarkably stable in moderate chop. The open-air deck, carbon-fibre hull, and minimalist Scandinavian interior make this the most photographed vessel in the Balearics. Expect €2,500–€5,000/day including skipper.
      </p>

      <h3>2. The Flybridge Motor Yacht (50–65ft)</h3>
      <p>
        For groups of 8–14 who want multiple sundecks, a shaded salon, and the option to overnight in Ibiza before
        returning to Mallorca, the flybridge motor yacht is the definitive <strong>luxury transfer</strong> choice. The elevated flybridge provides 360° views across the Balearic Sea, while the main deck
        salon offers an air-conditioned retreat. Rates: €4,500–€12,000/day.
      </p>

      <h3>3. The Luxury Catamaran</h3>
      <p>
        Families chartering <strong>a private vessel for this route</strong> with children or guests sensitive to
        motion consistently choose catamarans. The wide beam eliminates rolling, and the generous deck space provides
        the freedom to move around during the crossing. An added bonus: catamarans can anchor in shallow-water coves
        near Ibiza that monohulls cannot reach. Rates: €3,000–€8,000/day.
      </p>

      <h3>4. The Gulet (Traditional Turkish Wooden Yacht)</h3>
      <p>
        A gulet is the romantic alternative — handcrafted wooden decks, a shaded rear awning, and a pace that invites
        you to truly experience the Mediterranean rather than transit it. While the crossing takes longer at 6–8 hours,
        the atmosphere aboard is incomparable. This is the preferred vessel for honeymoon or anniversary
        <strong>Balearic crossing</strong> charters. Rates: €1,800–€4,500/day.
      </p>

      <h3>5. The Superyacht (60ft+)</h3>
      <p>
        For those who regard the <strong>island-hopping</strong> crossing as just one chapter in a
        multi-day Balearic itinerary, a crewed superyacht delivers unmatched luxury. A dedicated captain, chef, and crew
        of 3–6 attend to every detail. Wake up anchored off Formentera, cross to Ibiza for dinner at Nobu, return to
        Mallorca for a private beach club arrival. Rates: €8,000–€25,000+/day, plus APA.
      </p>

      <h2 id="departure-arrival">4. Best Departure & Arrival Points for a Private Boat Mallorca to Ibiza</h2>

      <p>
        Your choice of marina defines the character of your <strong>nautical voyage</strong>.
        According to <a href="https://www.yachtharbour.com/news/the-best-marinas-in-the-balearic-islands-61"
          target="_blank" rel="dofollow noopener">Yacht Harbour's Balearic marina guide</a>, the southwestern marinas of

        availability.
      </p>

      <h3>Mallorca Departure Points</h3>
      <ul class="luxury-list">
        <li><strong>Port d'Andratx:</strong> The premier departure point for any <strong>Balearic transfer</strong> crossing. Located on the southwestern tip of Mallorca, it is the closest major marina to Ibiza
          — saving approximately 45 minutes of open-water time versus departing from Palma.</li>
        <li><strong>Puerto Portals:</strong> Known as "Millionaire's Row," this is Mallorca's most glamorous marina and
          offers the widest selection of luxury yachts for hire. The 30-minute drive from Palma Airport makes it the top
          choice for fly-and-sail clients.</li>
        <li><strong>Port Adriano:</strong> Designed by Philippe Starck, this ultra-modern marina is the most
          architecturally striking departure point on the island. Its deep-water berths accommodate superyachts to 80m.
        </li>

      <h3>Ibiza Arrival Points</h3>

          distance.</li>

          arrange a dedicated tender to collect you from the anchorage — you step ashore without touching a marina
          berth.</li>
        <li><strong>Santa Eulalia Marina:</strong> A quieter, more refined arrival on Ibiza's eastern coast. Perfect for
          villa-based travellers who prefer a peaceful atmosphere over the intensity of Ibiza Town.</li>
        <li><strong>Formentera Day Stop:</strong> A <strong>private boat charter between the islands</strong> allows you
          to stop at Formentera's crystal shallows — a privilege no ferry offers. Anchor at Ses Illetes for 2 hours
          before completing the final leg to Ibiza.</li>
      </ul>

      <!-- ===== SECTION 5: BEST TIME ===== -->
      <h2 id="best-time">5. Best Time to Charter a Private Boat</h2>

      <p>
        Timing your <strong>Mallorca to Ibiza private boat</strong> charter correctly can save you thousands of euros
        and deliver a far superior experience. The Balearic season runs from April to October, with each month offering
        distinct advantages.
      </p>

      <h3>May & June — The Connoisseur's Choice</h3>
      <p>
        Sea temperatures of 20–22°C, virtually no crowds, and charter rates 25–35% below peak levels. Ibiza's beach
        clubs are open but not yet overwhelmed. June in particular delivers the best weather reliability for <strong>this Mediterranean crossing</strong> — calm seas and long evenings of golden Mediterranean light.
      </p>

      <h3>July & August — Peak Season</h3>
      <p>
        The most vibrant period to make <strong>the island crossing</strong>. Both islands are
        at full energy — the beach clubs, restaurants, and marinas are buzzing. However, availability is extremely
        limited and prices are 30–50% higher. Book at least 3–4 months in advance for July and August charters. The
        Balearic Islands Tourism Authority confirms that <a href="https://www.illesbalears.travel/en/" target="_blank"
          rel="dofollow noopener">peak season visitor numbers hit record highs in 2025</a>, and 2026 is expected to
        match or exceed those figures.
      </p>

      <h3>September — The Insider's Window</h3>
      <p>
        September is widely considered the finest month for an elite <strong>Balearic yacht charter</strong>. Prices begin to ease, crowds thin, but the sea is at its warmest (24–25°C) and the weather remains
        highly reliable. Many experienced travellers time their Balearic crossing specifically for the first two weeks
        of September for this reason.
      </p>

            // Callout logic
            let calloutText = "";
            if (size >= 7) {

                if (size >= 15) {

                calloutText = `For groups of ${size}, a ${vessel} works out cheaper per person than Gold Class ferry (€195).`;

        function dismissStickyMobileCta(event) {
            event.stopPropagation();
            event.preventDefault();

            cta.style.transform = 'translateY(100px)';
            cta.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => {
                cta.style.display = 'none';
            }, 500);
            sessionStorage.setItem('sticky_dismissed', '1');
        }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
            // Check if on mobile (screen under 768px)
            if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
                document.getElementById('stickyMobileCta').style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }

            if (sessionStorage.getItem('sticky_dismissed') === '1') {
                return;
            }

            const cta = document.getElementById('stickyMobileCta');
            if (window.scrollY > 400) {
                if (cta.style.display !== 'block') {
                    cta.style.display = 'block';
                    cta.offsetHeight; // force reflow
                    cta.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                    cta.style.opacity = '1';
                }
            } else {
                if (cta.style.display === 'block') {
                    cta.style.transform = 'translateY(100px)';
                    cta.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (window.scrollY <= 400) {
                            cta.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    }, 500);
                }
            }
        });
    </script>

        function toggleFaq(btn) {
            var item = btn.parentElement;
            var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
            // Close all
            document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function (el) {
                el.classList.remove('open');
                el.querySelector('.faq-q').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            });
            // Open clicked if was closed
            if (!isOpen) {
                item.classList.add('open');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            }
        }
